Maria J: FYI customer AtlasHealth opened a request for 'Catalyst-70B' to run in their VPC (private). They want quantization guidance + a quality pass for clinical summaries. Intake form: https://intra.redwood/requests/AT-342
Kevin L: Rough perf targets from the ask? qps/latency/cost expectations? Also, will they accept small accuracy delta for int8/4-bit?
Maria J: They asked for < 300ms p50 at 8k context for typical prompts, and total inference TCO comparable to our dedicated 4xA100 setup. Accuracy tolerance is tight: <= 2% drop on our clinical QA evals.
Simon ML: Catalyst-70B is a LLaMA-derivative with rotary mix & some custom attention twists. Quant path likely needs careful kernel selection. My plan: start with a baseline FP16 run, then try 8-bit symmetric, then nf4 4-bit. Watch for activation overflow on long context.
Tara Ops: I can provision a small staging pod (1xA100-80GB) for onboarding tests. Need a ticket with HSM/KMS flags for private deploy.
Maria J: Yes, AtlasHealth mandates HSM + audit logging. @Tara Ops can you add KMS tag?
ops-bot: Ticket created: #4532 - "AtlasHealth Catalyst-70B private onboarding". Staging window requested: 2026-04-02 09:00-13:00 UTC. Assigned: Tara Ops, Simon ML.
eval-bot: Running smoke eval on staging (baseline FP16). Command: ```run_eval --model=catalyst-70b --dataset=med-smoke --context=8k --mode=baseline```
eval-bot: Results (smoke): PPL=12.3, QA-F1=0.842, hallucination-rate=0.07. Latency p50 (fp16, staged): 280ms.
Simon ML: Good baseline. Next steps: 1) conversion to quant backend (trial nf4 + act-ordering), 2) run our safety/test-suite (clinical hallucinations + refusal rate), 3) human eval on 200-case clinical QA set.
Simon ML: Quick conversion command I'll run: ```python convert_model.py --model=catalyst-70b --out=/staging/catalyst70b/quant-nf4 --bits=4 --format=ggml```
Kevin L: For prioritization: should we do quant experiments before or after the full human eval? My vote: run quant vs fp16 automated diff first, if delta < 1% on QA-F1 then schedule human eval on a smaller sample. If >=1% then block and investigate.
Maria J: Agreed. Also need a rollout plan for private customers: canary on 1 tenant, then 10 then full. Add check: embedding drift comparison for search features.
Tara Ops: I'll add the HSM/KMS tags to ticket #4532 and provision the node. ETA for staging ready: 2 hours after approval.
Simon ML: Starting conversion job now, logs -> /staging/catalyst70b/conv-1790001234/logs.txt. Will post a short summary when finished.
Maria J: Awesome, thx all :thumbsup:
Kevin L: I'll add the prioritization matrix to the ticket (latency vs accuracy vs dev effort).
Simon ML: FYI past 4-bit runs on similar models had weird tokenization drift; will include tokenization sanity checks.
Maria J: Ok let's reconvene tomorrow 10:00 UTC for triage + go/no-go. Tara Ops: can you confirm then?
Tara Ops: Confirmed, see calendar invite.
